searchText: I completely wiped my kiln-lighthouse-besu configuration and started from scratch, and it's now syncing correctly. Guess I'll do the same with all of the other clients. Still don't really understand why they all started throwing `WARN | EngineExchangeTransitionConfiguration | not called in 120 seconds, consensus client may not be connected` and refusing to communicate, but at least I know it's possible to get it working now. ...nope. As soon as I restart besu and lighthouse, lighthouse stops updating besu. Was synced to 64431, and now besu just sits at `Chain download complete`. I had the same thing happen on my nodes as well. Besu team is aware of a sync issue and I think they already have a PR and eventual release for it. Use 8550 port instead of 8551 for --execution-endpoints. 8550 is occupied by nethermind. All of my besu instances are already using custom ports. Currently, this is what I think is happening: `--engine-rpc-http-port` is the port that should be listening on 8551 but it is on 8550. `--engine-rpc-ws-port` this is the one listening on 8551 (and doesn't accept HTTP requests). So you should point your CL client to `--engine-rpc-http-port` (except from Nimbus that works on `--engine-rpc-ws-port`) Anyway, there is a problem with the sync process, it gets stuck at ~55.000. That API is used as a heartbeat between CL and EL. It is called at startup, and then monitored for regular calls. In case anyone needs it, `chaind` 0.6.0 is compatible with bellatrix so can run against kiln instances. nice, finally proposed my first block with erigon. excerpts.author: diegolosada
excerpts.content:
Currently, this is what I think is happening:

`--engine-rpc-http-port` is the port that should be listening on 8551 but it is on 8550.
`--engine-rpc-ws-port` this is the one listening on 8551 (and doesn't accept HTTP requests).

So you should point your CL client to `--engine-rpc-http-port` (except from Nimbus that works on `--engine-rpc-ws-port`)

Anyway, there is a problem with the sync process, it gets stuck at ~55.000.
